content: Membership goes through an exported type guard rather than a bare .includes(), because a narrow tuple's .includes() rejects the wide union at call sites. This is why warren-b229 changed RUN_TERMINAL_STATES and PLAN_RUN_TERMINAL_STATES from ReadonlySet to readonly tuples — a public SDK surface change (.has/.size become .includes/.length).

title: Canonical wire vocabulary lives in src/core/wire.ts, re-exported outward
rationale: The kernel imports nothing, so the Vite-bundled UI can reach it without dragging drizzle or bun:sqlite into the browser bundle. Defining in columns.ts and importing inward would have pulled the ORM into the UI bundle.
